core: Notch intracellular domain-driven target gene transcription
qualifier: NOTCH2/3/4 receptors and the cell-fate outputs they specify (Th2, pancreatic bud)
name: NOTCH2/3/4 intracellular domain transcription directing cell fate
rationale: Every member concerns transcription driven by released Notch intracellular domains or its fate outputs, and unlike the confusables the theme is built on NOTCH2/3/4 and downstream fate decisions rather than NOTCH1 activation, its oncogenic mutants or generic Notch target regulation.

core: inhibitory adrenergic receptor signalling that suppresses adenylate cyclase
qualifier: alpha-2 autoreceptor restraint of catecholamine and insulin release
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of adenylate cyclase and catecholamine release
rationale: All members are alpha-2/Gi-Gz adrenergic signalling events that lower cAMP and damp epinephrine, norepinephrine or insulin secretion, which separates them from confusables covering general cAMP/PKA second-messenger machinery or the cardiac and vascular effector responses to catecholamines.

core: dorsoventral patterning of the neural plate and spinal cord
qualifier: motor neuron and ventral interneuron fate specification
name: Spinal cord dorsoventral patterning and motor neuron fate specification
rationale: Each member is a neural plate, neural fold or spinal cord patterning step or a fate decision made along its dorsoventral axis, distinguishing it from confusables centred on hindbrain and brainstem development, axial mesoderm and notochord, or midbrain dopaminergic and serotonergic neurons.

core: circadian transcriptional control of glucose metabolism
qualifier: nutrient and redox sensing with pancreatic beta cell growth
name: Circadian transcriptional control of gluconeogenesis and beta cell nutrient sensing
rationale: Members couple clock transcription factors and activity-driven gene expression to gluconeogenesis, caloric restriction, redox state and beta cell development, whereas confusables are built around PGC-1alpha/PPARA mitochondrial biogenesis programmes or glucocorticoid and endocrine secretion responses.

core: monocyte and macrophage lineage identity programme in blood
qualifier: lineage-specifying and defense effector genes, not surface marker or inflammatory response sets
name: Monocyte-macrophage lineage identity and innate defense effector program
rationale: All members are blood expression modules or processes marking the mature monocyte-macrophage-neutrophil compartment and its defense machinery, while the confusables are instead monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures, neutrophil degranulation and inflammatory response sets, or TLR inflammatory signalling.

core: iron-sulfur cluster assembly and delivery to client enzymes
qualifier: support of TCA enzymes and of tetrapyrrole/hemoglobin synthesis regulation
name: Iron-sulfur cluster assembly supplying TCA enzymes and heme synthesis
rationale: Members are [2Fe-2S]/[4Fe-4S] cluster assembly, its mitochondrial export transporters and the client processes (TCA enzyme maturation, regulation of tetrapyrrole and hemoglobin synthesis), unlike confusables that carry the heme biosynthetic reactions themselves, respiratory complex III assembly or ferredoxin-dependent steroidogenesis.

core: dietary lipid digestion, intestinal absorption and lipoprotein assembly
qualifier: enterocyte sterol handling and chylomicron/VLDL secretion
name: Dietary lipid digestion, intestinal absorption and lipoprotein particle assembly
rationale: Every member concerns uptake of dietary lipid and sterol across the gut and packaging of it into secreted lipoprotein particles, whereas the confusables concern circulating lipoprotein remodelling and clearance, lipase complexes and cholesterol efflux regulation.

core: nuclear mRNA 3'-end processing, termination and export
qualifier: histone pre-mRNA stem-loop route and snRNP/cap maturation
name: Nuclear mRNA 3'-end processing, termination and nuclear export
rationale: All members act on nascent transcript 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation, Pol II termination and the delivery of mature mRNA through the pore, which distinguishes it from confusables centred on splicing, cytoplasmic mRNA decay, or snRNA and lncRNA transcription.

core: regulation of innate pattern-recognition and costimulatory signalling in myeloid antigen-presenting cells
qualifier: toll-like receptor, MyD88 and CD40 signalling in monocytes and dendritic cells
name: Myeloid toll-like receptor and CD40 signaling regulation
rationale: Members are monocyte and dendritic cell modules together with regulation of TLR/MyD88, CD40 and MHC class II signalling, setting the theme apart from confusables built on Fc receptor and neutrophil effector signalling, on individual cytokine production control, or on myeloid lineage identity modules.

core: very-long-chain fatty acid elongation and peroxisomal beta-oxidation
qualifier: ether lipid and plasmalogen synthesis from the same acyl-CoA pool
name: Very-long-chain fatty acid elongation and peroxisomal beta-oxidation
rationale: All members handle long and very-long-chain acyl-CoA synthesis, elongation, peroxisomal breakdown or ether lipid products of it, unlike confusables that cover peroxisomal protein import and biogenesis, alpha-oxidation of branched fatty acids, or cholesterol and isoprenoid biosynthesis.

core: clostridial neurotoxin action on synaptic vesicle fusion machinery
qualifier: SNARE proteolysis that blocks neurotransmitter release
name: Clostridial neurotoxin cleavage of synaptic SNAREs blocking neurotransmitter release
rationale: Every member is a clostridial neurotoxin serotype acting on the presynaptic SNARE machinery, whereas all confusables are endogenous neurotransmitter synthesis, loading, reuptake and receptor pathways with no toxin component.

core: APC/C-dependent ubiquitin-mediated proteolysis at the metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit
qualifier: control of APC/C coactivator switching and inhibitors rather than spindle or cohesion mechanics
name: APC/C-mediated degradation driving metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit
rationale: All members are APC/C substrate degradation events, APC/C activation or inhibition steps and the regulation of exit from mitosis, in contrast to confusables covering spindle assembly and checkpoint signalling, sister chromatid cohesion, or G2/M entry and p53-driven cell cycle transcription.

core: glycerophospholipid head-group synthesis and acyl-chain remodelling
qualifier: cardiolipin and N-acylethanolamine/endocannabinoid arms, excluding neutral and sphingolipids
name: Glycerophospholipid synthesis, acyl-chain remodeling and N-acylethanolamine turnover
rationale: Every member builds, remodels or hydrolyses a diacyl glycerophospholipid or an N-acyl derivative of one, which separates it from confusables that add phosphatidylinositol transfer between membranes, neutral lipid (DAG/TAG/PA) synthesis, or sphingolipid metabolism.

core: circulating lipoprotein particle remodelling and receptor-mediated clearance
qualifier: cellular cholesterol uptake and storage responses to those particles
name: Plasma lipoprotein remodeling, clearance and cholesterol uptake
rationale: All members concern the fate of lipoprotein particles already in plasma - their remodelling, clearance and the cholesterol import and storage that follows - unlike confusables centred on chylomicron remodelling and lipase assembly, intestinal absorption and particle assembly with efflux regulation, or foam cell formation from oxidised LDL.

core: COPI-coated vesicle traffic within the Golgi and back to the ER
qualifier: retrograde COPI route, not COPII ER exit or Golgi structural dynamics
name: COPI-mediated intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport
rationale: Each member is a COPI budding or recycling step between Golgi cisternae or from Golgi to ER, distinguishing the theme from confusables covering COPII-dependent ER exit, Golgi ribbon disassembly and reorganisation, or trans-Golgi and lysosomal vesicle biogenesis.

core: retinoid metabolism and the visual retinoid cycle
qualifier: retinoic acid synthesis and catabolism alongside chromophore regeneration
name: Retinoid metabolism, retinoic acid signaling and visual cycle
rationale: All members handle vitamin A derivatives - their transport, oxidation, catabolism, the rod and cone retinoid cycles and the diseases of those steps - whereas confusables cover vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism, the opsin phototransduction cascade itself, or steroidogenic cytochrome P450 reactions.

core: oncogene-induced senescence with chromatin-based proliferative arrest
qualifier: senescence-associated heterochromatin foci and blocked G0 to G1 re-entry
name: Oncogene-induced senescence with senescence-associated heterochromatin formation
rationale: Members tie oncogene-triggered senescence to heterochromatin formation and the cell cycle exit it enforces, unlike confusables that add the secretory phenotype, oxidative-stress and replicative senescence, or p16INK4A/p14ARF defects that let cells evade senescence.

core: receptor-mediated amplification of beta cell insulin secretion
qualifier: free fatty acid, muscarinic and incretin inputs
name: Incretin, muscarinic and fatty acid receptor amplification of insulin secretion
rationale: All three members are receptor-driven potentiators of insulin release, which distinguishes the theme from confusables covering adrenergic inhibition of secretion, glucagon and somatostatin receptor signalling, or insulin processing and incretin hormone synthesis.

core: death receptor and mitochondrial apoptosis execution with regulated necrosis
qualifier: effector machinery (BH3-only/BAX-BAK, apoptosome, caspase-8, RIPK1) rather than p53 transcriptional control
name: Death receptor and mitochondrial apoptosis execution with necroptosis
rationale: Every member is a step or regulator of committed cell death - BH3-only activation and outer membrane permeabilisation, cytochrome c release, apoptosome and caspase-8 control, death receptor and TRIF/RIPK1 necroptotic signalling, and nuclear demolition - whereas the confusables are dominated by p53-driven transcription of death genes, senescence programmes and PAK-2p34 signalling.

core: sulfated glycosaminoglycan chain polymerisation on proteoglycans
qualifier: heparan/heparin and chondroitin/dermatan chain elongation, not the linker tetrasaccharide or sulfotransferase steps
name: Heparan and chondroitin/dermatan sulfate chain elongation on proteoglycans
rationale: All members build the repeating GAG chains of heparan, heparin, chondroitin or dermatan sulfate proteoglycans, including the EXT1/EXT2 polymerase defects, which separates them from confusables centred on the protein-linkage region and its disorders or on O-linked fucose and glucose glycosylation of TSR domains.

core: phospholipase A2 arachidonate release and regulation of prostaglandin output
qualifier: prostaglandin E responses and fever generation, excluding the leukotriene branch and cyclooxygenase chemistry
name: Regulated arachidonate release and prostaglandin output in fever
rationale: Members cover mobilisation of arachidonate from membrane phospholipid and the up- and down-regulation of prostaglandin synthesis, secretion and response including fever, unlike confusables that carry leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis and receptors or the cyclooxygenase and prostanoid receptor reactions themselves.

core: immunological synapse assembly with lymphocyte polarisation
qualifier: membrane raft clustering at the contact site, not integrin adhesion or chemotactic GTPase signalling
name: Immunological synapse assembly and T cell polarity
rationale: All four members describe forming the polarised lymphocyte contact zone and the raft clustering and aggregation it requires, whereas confusables cover integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and migration or Rho-family GTPase and chemokine receptor signalling.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription with rRNA processing and translation initiation
qualifier: the transcription and initiation machinery itself, not its chromatin or MYC-driven regulation
name: RNA polymerase I and III transcription and translation initiation
rationale: Members are Pol I and Pol III initiation, elongation and termination steps, the rRNA cleavage events that follow, and ribosomal subunit joining and initiation complex formation, distinguishing the theme from confusables weighted towards nucleolar chromatin and SIRT1/MYC regulation of rRNA expression or snRNA and tRNA transcription.

core: central nervous system myelin formation and maintenance by oligodendrocyte lineage cells
qualifier: CNS myelin with oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and reactive gliosis
name: Oligodendrocyte central nervous system myelination and reactive gliosis
rationale: Each member concerns making, maintaining or limiting CNS myelin and the oligodendrocyte lineage and glial reaction around it, unlike confusables centred on Schwann cell and peripheral myelin, axon regeneration after injury, astrocyte migration and activation, or axonal domain and node assembly.

core: anteroposterior and dorsoventral patterning of the embryonic trunk axis
qualifier: neural plate and neural tube regionalisation with somitogenesis and axial mesoderm, not limb Hox or craniofacial programmes
name: Trunk axis patterning of neural tube, somites and axial mesoderm
rationale: All members specify position and fate along the elongating embryonic body axis - neural plate formation and regionalisation, neural tube dorsoventral patterning, somite segmentation and axial mesoderm - whereas the confusables add Hox cluster activation with limb and digit morphogenesis, or TFAP2-driven craniofacial, placodal and organ primordium development.
